changelog:
Vanguard v1.0.26

30k reliability fix.

30k
- Fixed normal (no-buffer) 30k forwarding inbound TCP control packets (RST/FIN). While 30k was active the server's connection reset could reach the game and error-code the instance, most noticeably when toggling 30k off after ~10 seconds. These control packets are now blocked like every other inbound instance packet, matching intended behavior.

No other changes to packet logic or the 27k behavior.
